payload.text: 0352's shape, vc's word to cc 2026-11-17 by 10:37Z by date -u on cc's pick; ic has never run, so it stands on cc's design and vc's word. bin/devbin release target [--ref <ref>] is read only (config and tree; no tags, no network, no lock, no write) and prints DEVBIN_RELEASE_VERSION and DEVBIN_RELEASE_TARGET_TAG, the pair a cut hands its project's own commands (lib/release.steps:662, release.md:140), from the one function gates_verb uses. Filed for 0.1.27: 0362 and 0363 by cc (c3377c71; 0362 rides 0358's unit, 0363 is cc's after 0358), 0364 to 0369 by dc (c478a902, todo 214's findings). cc's order: 0354, 0352, 0358 with 0362, then 0363. dc's: 0355, 0360, 0359.
